ext4.note: gate column: numbers here are measured on the repository's real filesystem

tmpfs.note: labelled second column only: fdatasync is a no-op on tmpfs, so no durability claim

ext4.procedure: read /proc/self/status twice - before `open()` and after the last append - and report the difference; since ADR-005 the segment is not mapped, so a shared file mapping's RssFile accounting does not apply and the batch buffer (16 KiB + 1 MiB worst case) is RssAnon

tmpfs.procedure: read /proc/self/status twice - before `open()` and after the last append - and report the difference; since ADR-005 the segment is not mapped, so a shared file mapping's RssFile accounting does not apply and the batch buffer (16 KiB + 1 MiB worst case) is RssAnon
